function.name: weather_forecast
function.description: Retrieves the weather forecast for a specified location and date, including temperature, precipitation, and wind conditions. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The geographic location for the forecast, in the format 'City, State' or 'City, Country', such as 'San Francisco, CA' or 'London, UK'.

date.description: The date for which the forecast is being retrieved, formatted as 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

temperature_unit.description: The unit of measurement for temperature.

include_humidity.description: Whether to include humidity percentage in the forecast.

include_wind.description: Whether to include wind speed and direction in the forecast.

**Shashi Tej Reddy** is an Indian politician who has spent most of his career in the politics of the southern state of Telangana (and, before the 2014 state‑bifurcation, in Andhra Pradesh). | Aspect | Details | |--------|---------| | **Political affiliation** | Indian National Congress (INC) – he has been a long‑time member of the party’s Telangana unit. | | **Legislative career** | • Member of the Andhra Pradesh Legislative Assembly (MLA) from the Narsapur constituency (1999‑2004).
• After the creation of Telangana in 2014, he was elected again as MLA from Narsapur and has served in the Telangana Legislative Assembly since then. | | **Ministerial roles** | • **Minister for Rural Development & Panchayats, Andhra Pradesh** (2004‑2009) under Chief Minister N. T. Rama Rao.
• **Minister for Rural Development & Panchayats, Telangana** (2014‑2018) in the cabinet of Chief Minister K. Chandrasekhar Rao. | | **Key focus areas** | • Rural development schemes (e.g., irrigation, rural electrification, and agricultural support).
• Panchayat reforms and decentralised governance.
• Water‑resource management and rural infrastructure projects. | | **Background** | Born in the early 1950s in the Narsapur region, Reddy has a background in agriculture and local governance. He entered politics through the INC’s grassroots network and quickly rose to prominence due to his work on rural issues. | | **Notable achievements** | • Oversaw the implementation of several flagship rural development programmes in both Andhra Pradesh and Telangana.
• Played a key role in the transition of rural development policies during the state‑bifurcation period.
• Known for his advocacy of stronger panchayat institutions and community participation in local governance. | **In short:** Shashi Tej Reddy is a seasoned INC politician from Telangana, best known for his tenure as Minister for Rural Development & Panchayats in both Andhra Pradesh (pre‑2014) and Telangana (post‑2014), and for his long‑standing representation of the Narsapur constituency in the state legislatures.
